# nix-setup

> Set up or troubleshoot requested or existing Nix environments, including flakes, buildNpmPackage, direnv, CI, and per-language templates. Use the devbox reference only when the project already uses devbox or the user explicitly selects it; do not introduce devbox by default for new projects.

## Install

### APM (recommended)

```bash
apm install mizchi/skills/nix-setup
```

Or declare it in `apm.yml` for a reproducible setup:

```yaml
dependencies:
  apm:
    - mizchi/skills/nix-setup
```

then run `apm install`.

### Any agentskills.io-compatible agent

This is an [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) skill — a portable
`SKILL.md` folder that works with Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Gemini CLI,
Cursor, and other [compatible agents](https://agentskills.io/clients).
